description: This Java class defines an IntelliJ IDEA inspection that detects non-constant resource IDs used in switch statements within Android projects, and provides a quick fix to convert switch statements to if-else chains.

classes.name: AndroidNonConstantResIdsInSwitchInspection
classes.description: An inspection tool for detecting non-constant resource IDs in switch statements in Android code, with an associated quick fix.

methods.name: getGroupDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the inspection group.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of this specific inspection.

methods.name: getShortName
methods.description: Returns the short identifier name for the inspection.

methods.name: buildVisitor
methods.description: Builds a visitor that inspects switch labels for non-constant resource IDs.

methods.name: getQuickFixName
methods.description: Returns the name of the quick fix associated with this inspection.
